scientific_integrity: The exact 40-entry profile and two extremizers are checked independently by an exhaustive C++ unordered-triple enumerator and a Python shift-union bitset enumerator, each covering all 1,221,759 normalized sets in [0,45]. All published-source assertions are distinguished from finite computations.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for six-point triple sumsets only. Unbounded exclusion of cardinality 17 depends on Rajagopal Theorem 1.7. Possible earlier separate optimal B3 example tables not exhaustively indexed. Programs provide reproducible finite exhaustive computation, not independent mathematical certification.
title: Exact inverse-diameter profile of six-point triple sumsets
